# @codenhub/icons

> Zero-runtime icon system: icon classes in markup become CSS mask rules at build time, drawn from generated icon families that carry their own license notices.

- An icon is `prefix:name`, written `ic-prefix-name` as a class. Unprefixed names resolve through a curated semantic map, then through the configured default prefix.
- Families are data, imported from `@codenhub/icons/data/<prefix>` and passed to a plugin. Nothing is bundled by default.
- Variants such as filled or duotone are separate families with their own prefixes, never options on one family.
- Stroke width applies only to families drawn with strokes; filled families ignore it.
- `stroke`, `after`, and `bg` are reserved words in the class syntax and cannot be family prefixes.
- The build emits the license notices required by the families it used, controlled by the `attribution` option.

## Documentation

- [Overview](docs/index.md): families, name resolution, the Vite and PostCSS plugins, the JavaScript API, and licensing.
- [README](README.md): purpose, installation, and the shortest working setup.

## Optional

- [NOTICE](NOTICE): third-party copyright and license notices for the bundled artwork.
